data.desc: Abundia Global Impact Group, Inc. (NYSE American: AGIG), is a low-carbon energy company focused on converting waste into value. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Abundia is developing commercial-scale facilities that transform waste plastics and biomass into drop-in fuels and low-carbon chemical feedstocks. The flagship project at Cedar Port positions Abundia at the center of the Gulf Coast's energy and chemical infrastructure, with access to feedstock supply chains, upgrading partners, and end markets.
